root_cause_F_NEW_588.title: ALooper CALLBACK-mode contract — the exact missing contract
root_cause_F_NEW_588.gap: scripts/cont83_android_anchor.c ALooper_addFd discarded the callback ('(void)callback'); the engine registers its timerfd in CALLBACK mode (ident==ALOOPER_POLL_CALLBACK, callback reads/drains the timerfd). A fired timerfd stays level-triggered EPOLLIN forever -> epoll_wait returns instantly, forever -> raster/io burn 100% CPU -> Shell::Create latch on the platform thread never closes -> the W8 five-thread stall.
root_cause_F_NEW_588.also_wrong: return constants: ours POLL_CALLBACK=1/TIMEOUT=-2/ERROR=-3 vs AOSP -2/-3/-4; pollAll missing (dartjni face); EINTR answered as spurious WAKE.
root_cause_F_NEW_588.fix: AOSP Looper.cpp contract restored: exact constants; addFd validates ident (-2 callback mode w/ required callback, >=0 data mode, else error); pollOnce dispatches ONE event (callback invoked, its fd drained, callback's return returned; data mode fills outs and returns ident); pollAll added (continuous callback dispatch, first wait honors timeout, subsequent 0ms); EINTR retries; EVENT<->EPOLL bit translation incl.
